memories.content: Lives near the proposed site. Has received many emails from constituents both for and against the relocation. Personally leans against the move due to noise concerns but has not publicly stated a position.

The Riverton parks committee will hold a session on Thursday, 2026-09-17, to vote on the skate-park relocation. The proposal has been through two noisy public-comment periods. The local paper ran letters both for and against last week. The committee has five members.
